title: Dice & Dusk
description: Roll three dice, read visible enemy intents, and balance steel, guard and poison through five candlelit encounters and a two-phase boss.
controls: Click or tap a die, then an action
Click a filled action to free its die
credits: Designed and developed with Kimi for Kimi Games.
Original SVG monsters, interface, animation and synthesized audio created for this game.
No third-party runtime libraries or external assets.
